title: Can I BEAT Secret Queen Chess?
summary: First Secret Queen episode, played online on a custom variant site (3:00 clocks, provisional rating) against human opponents (e.g. a 1633-rated player, EduNel 1518). Each player secretly selects one of their pawns to be a hidden queen that can move like a queen. The secret queen is revealed if it gives check, promotes, or makes a non-pawn move. Narrator picks f2 for scholar's-mate-style tricks; goal is to win three games; ends with a ~1600 placeholder rating after 3 wins and 3 losses.
rules: Pre-game: each player secretly selects one of their pawns as the Secret Queen (confirm button); marked with a purple star only for its owner.
The secret-queen pawn moves like a pawn or like a queen.
It is revealed to the opponent if it gives check, promotes, or moves in a way a pawn cannot.
Unrevealed, it looks like an ordinary pawn to the opponent.
win_condition: Checkmate/flag the opponent; aim to win three games.

board.theme_notes: brown/cream board on custom site, blue 3:00 clock badges, green arrows; purple star on own secret pawn.
